title: TensorTransit plan
description: A compiled Transit Plan: the locality actions a planner chose, the tensors it declined and why, and what its cost model believes the plan is worth. Nothing in cost_model is a measurement; `basis` says so in the document itself so that anything printing a predicted figure next to a measured one has to distinguish them.

resident_bytes.description: What the plan asks the persisting partition to hold: quantised to cache lines and charged once per tensor. NOT committed_bytes -- per-consumer binding commits the same region several times, and a hit ratio means a committed region is not wholly resident.

stream_relieved_bytes.description: Interference a Stream action takes out of the picture. Zero under the linear model, which is why a Stream action was priced at zero there.

predicted_gross_saved_bytes.description: The saving BEFORE the reservation's own cost. Kept apart from the net figure so a reader can see a plan whose policy works and whose set-aside is not worth it -- which is what the concurrency arms measure, and a single net number cannot say.

reservation_cost_bytes.description: What the set-aside costs the traffic it displaces. The only term that can make a prediction negative, and the concurrency arms are negative.

cost_model.description: Which model produced predicted_saved_bytes, recorded next to the number: the two can differ by an order of magnitude on the same plan, and a prediction whose model is not on the page is this project's recurring failure.
